_comment: Where the playground fetches full BIDS datasets from. Each model's payload JSON names its own archive (ds-<lowercased BIDS suffix>.zip); this file says only which host and record serves them, so adding a model needs no edit here. Built and zipped by scripts/make_bids_examples.sh --zip.
_url_form: Must be Zenodo's /api/ content URL. The human-facing /records/<id>/files/<name>?download=1 form sends no Access-Control-Allow-Origin and is blocked by the browser; the /api/ form sends 'ACAO: *'. Verified in a real browser, not just from headers.
